notes.title: [Patch Notes] Alpha 2.1.0
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, dear friends, with each passing day we are getting closer and closer to having a stable server :D
Our goal is to have everything ready for the beta tests that will start soon, so please be patient.
I’m here to provide a summary of what’s included in this update below:[/p][p][b]1 - Septaria Bonus System[/b][/p][p] "Achievement Treasure" system has been added.[/p][olist][*][p]The Achievement Treasure can be equipped in \[Achievement Treasures > Rest of the Sea Dragon], a system that allows you to produce special items every day.[/p][/*][*][p]Up to three Achievement Treasures can be equipped, and the quantity of items produced varies depending on the level of the equipped Achievement Treasure.[/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]Rewards obtainable through Achievement Treasures are renewed every day at 4 AM and can be collected later at \[Achievement Treasures > Rest of the Sea Dragon].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/20ae2018cac002144ad2829d57b765ca8331d370.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/e34a76cfd5678f1c8879b0d5a975d2680ec7dc76.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]Promotion offers a certain chance to increase the level of your Achievement Treasure by one level.[/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]A total of 4 Achievement Treasures are used in promotion, and the success probability for promotion is the same at all levels, 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon a successful upgrade, you can obtain 1 Achievement Treasure of a higher level.[/p][/*][*][p]If the promotion fails, all other Achievement Treasures, except the first registered Achievement Treasure, will disappear.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]The Achievement Treasure ‘Advanced/Rare/Heroic/Legendary Blue Breath Crystal’ has been added.[/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]When equipped with the 'Blue Breath Crystal', you can receive the 'Blue Treasure Stone' every day at the Sea Dragon’s resting place.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mythic Items[/b][/p][olist][*][p]The ancient sacred item 'Ragnos’ Necklace' has been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/703b67f8ca8bc1e30d772a32602fdbc8e13d3f72.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][olist][*][p]The default options for Ragnos’ Necklace consist of health, reduced PvP damage received, and increased heavy attack damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon reaching the Rare/Heroic/Legendary ranks, you can unlock additional stats.[/p][/*][/olist][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Achievement Rank[/p][/th][th][p]Unlocked Options[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]Increased probability of weakening resistance[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Heroic[/p][/td][td][p]Reduces all damage received[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]Fatal[/p][/td][/tr][/table][olist][*][p]Upon reaching the Heroic/Legendary/Mythic ranks, a unique effect is unlocked, and this effect grows with the rank of the Old God.[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/f4c8c6e2af1e35b899604a96da8a367b93e8850d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/bb37c66bf83d5e16a8103452c8c3c7432ff14b90.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/120c731f77f230841d0396855b9fee52374a2078.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,229"][tr][th][p]Unlock Level[/p][/th][th][p]Unique Effect Name[/p][/th][th colwidth="229"][p]Applied Effect[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Heroic[/p][/td][td][p]Survival Instinct[/p][/td][td colwidth="229"][p]When remaining stamina falls below 30~45%, PvP damage received decreases by 20~50% for 15 seconds. (Cooldown: 75 seconds)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]Blade of the Rush[/p][/td][td colwidth="229"][p]When attacking, there is a 15% chance of fatal attack damage increasing by 35~50% for 30 seconds. (Cooldown: 80 seconds)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Mythic[/p][/td][td][p]\[Party Leader] Red Pledge[/p][/td][td colwidth="229"][p]When attacking, there is a 15% chance that the critical attack damage of nearby party members increases by 50% for 30 seconds. (Cooldown: 80 seconds)[/p][/td][/tr][/table][olist][*][p]The interface of the Old Gods tab changes, and a slot for equipping 'Ragnos’ Necklace' is opened.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]\[Crafting of Septaria-Based Items Added][/b]
Now it’s possible to craft your Ragnos Ring without a headache (we will reduce the required amount during the Beta).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/ff10f0c541a1176ba7c947b390a2b303535ee1dc.png"][/img]
[/p][p]That’s all for now. We’ll bring more news soon :D
Thank you for your patience, and please report any bugs on the Alpha Discord.[/p][p]Best regards,
Nexus M4 Team[/p]

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Alpha Update 1.9.1
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Nexus M4 Adventurers![/p][p]We are thrilled to announce the latest Nexus M4 update, introducing brand-new content and improvements that will take your gaming experience to the next level! Check out the highlights:[/p][p][b]\[Main Updates][/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]New Challenge: Tower of Fate[/b]
The Tower of Fate is the latest challenge content, where you can test your skills by facing increasingly powerful monsters across various difficulty levels.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/8dc0be729d1c50dd00499f1ce8328e73bebda300.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]How to access[/b]: Available for characters level 120 and above.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game mode[/b]: Form groups of up to 5 players to conquer the gates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rewards[/b]: Use the "Tower of Fate Entry Ticket" to participate and earn exclusive rewards upon completing each stage for the first time![/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]New Mythic Spirit: Kyssara[/b]
[i]Kyssara[/i] is a spirit that debilitates enemies with powerful negative effects and boosts allies to deal more lethal damage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/e65c53ef5b63156fba1434be3f1c0644c8d66fca.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]How to obtain[/b]: Visit the NPC [i]Wind Oracle[/i] in the Legendary Spirits Village and complete the [i]Origin[/i] quest.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]New Ancestral Equipment: Han Sul’s Shoulderguards[/b]
The mighty Han Sul’s Shoulderguards have arrived in Nexus M4![/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]How to acquire[/b]: Craft them with forge NPCs, purchase them in the store, or earn them through missions and heroic achievements.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]New Appearances: Ancestral Weapons[/b]
Ancestral-themed weapon skins, inspired by the mystical power of spirits, are now available for all classes![/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]How to obtain[/b]: Purchase exchange coupons in the store to unlock these exclusive appearances.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]More News Coming Soon![/b]
Stay tuned, as we’ll soon bring even more updates to make your Nexus M4 journey even more epic! Get ready to explore, conquer, and dominate!
[/p][p]Nexus M4 Team[/p]
